indicators.MC57: production 57 ETF x 12 equal-metric MC15 temperature
indicators.MC_pillars: momentum / breadth / trend / damage plus breadth level and 10-session change
indicators.F1: 20-session-ago top24 leader dropout rate; dashboard reference warning 20%, red 30%
indicators.F2: current top24 whose RS63 is below85; dashboard reference caution25%, red40%
indicators.F3: RS189>=85 queue in pullback/damage state; dashboard reference caution40%, red60%

design.threshold_policy: small predeclared grids around existing dashboard thresholds; no optimizer-selected arbitrary cutpoints
design.outcome: next-open to 5/10/20-session return of daily top12 normal-stock candidates, plus full normal-stock portfolio simulation
design.dependency_control: Spearman correlation table used to identify redundant indicators
design.uncertainty: 20-session cluster bootstrap CI for forward 20-session means

limitations: Normal-stock portfolio is the existing comparison reconstruction, not the missing exact production ledger.
Current-universe survivorship bias remains in leader/breadth features and stock outcomes.
Confirmation has already been inspected in prior research; it is robustness confirmation, not pristine OOS.
No dashboard or main-branch logic is changed by this audit.
